scenario.name: preflight
scenario.description: Authenticate and resolve a model/runtime-prepared session from sessions.list, or explicitly create and verify a disposable session, before read-only tools.effective inventory.

liveRunSafety.notes: The default live path validates a prepared session returned by sessions.list and remains read-only. OPENCLAW_PREFLIGHT_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true selects the explicit create-and-verify path. Session-resolution failures remain NO-VERDICT.

expectedReceipts.name: manifest-loaded
expectedReceipts.description: The exact row manifest used for the k6 run.

expectedReceipts.name: k6-summary
expectedReceipts.description: Raw k6 summary/export for the run.

expectedReceipts.name: seat-readiness
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe seat/tooling preflight: k6 path/version, gateway reachability, candidate SHA validity, env presence booleans, seat/session class, and concurrency safety.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-inventory
expectedReceipts.description: Live preflight only: tools.effective inventory for the target session.

expectedReceipts.name: session-inventory
expectedReceipts.description: Live preflight only: sessions.list/session resolution receipt.

expectedReceipts.name: session-preparation-authority
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe listed/disposable session class plus agent, model, runtime, preparation completion, and tools.effective call stage; raw session keys are excluded.

review.notes: Preflight should never write a product verdict by itself. Session/model preparation and gateway readiness failures are setup NO-VERDICT outcomes.
